reason: I spend about 2,400 a year on glazing damage, paid from contingency. You want 19,000 on a 1,000 m2 year to avoid that. I would be paying eight times the problem.
objection: The cost of the coating is many times what the damage costs me. I have never seen it on a Maltese job, and a 150 m2 minimum plus 50% deposit is a lot to ask of a new supplier.
instead: Carry on as now: clean and polish at snagging, pay for the odd replacement from contingency, and use cheap film and tape on the worst exposed frames if needed.
would_change_my_mind: A local job with a client I know, showing the all-in cost under about 3 euro per m2 and snagging savings bigger than that cost.
